column1: #   core     Unix commands from the ios_system ecosystem (BSD licensed).
#   network  Networking tools (ping, nslookup, dig, whois, nc, telnet, ifconfig).
#   crypto   OpenSSL and libssh2, required by ssh, scp, sftp, curl and lg2.
#   git      lg2, the libgit2 command line client (clone, pull, push, commit, ...).
#   shell    dash, a real POSIX sh used for scripts. dashA and dashB allow nesting.
# The ios_system framework itself is linked through Swift Package Manager
# (Packages/TernToolchain/Package.swift) because the app calls its C API directly.
# Everything below is loaded at runtime with dlopen by ios_system and only needs to be
# embedded in Tern.app/Frameworks. scripts/fetch-toolchain.sh downloads and verifies
# these archives; scripts/embed-toolchain.sh copies the right slice into the app.
